interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct wide, paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from high-speed traffic.

interventions.title: Hardened Separation
interventions.description: Replace flexible posts with a concrete curb or barrier to provide physical protection for the walkway and bike lane.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and RRFBs
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-scale lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting fixtures specifically designed to illuminate the sidewalk area, improving visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Enhanced landscaping
interventions.description: Improve the buffer zone with more dense or varied vegetation to better shield pedestrians from the parking lot environment.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk and a raised median refuge island to reduce crossing distance and exposure for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (HAWK)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to stop traffic for pedestrians wishing to cross this wide arterial road.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to improve pedestrian comfort and safety from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Landscaped Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number and width of curb cuts to minimize conflict points and slow down vehicles entering and exiting commercial lots.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to define a clear path for pedestrians and alert drivers to their presence.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Enhancements
interventions.description: Plant street trees in the buffer zone to provide a physical barrier and reduce the perceived width of the road, slowing traffic.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes or narrow existing lanes to slow traffic and provide space for pedestrian and bicycle infrastructure.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks with a central refuge island to reduce crossing distance and exposure.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous, paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Improvements
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and a median refuge island to facilitate safe crossing of the wide arterial.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Reconfigure the roadway to include fewer or narrower travel lanes and add a buffered pedestrian/bike zone to slow traffic.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Activated Signal
interventions.description: Install a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB) or HAWK signal to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians crossing the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk at Driveway
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings across the driveway entrance to define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Reduced Turning Radii
interventions.description: Tighten the curb radii at the driveway entrance to slow down vehicles entering and exiting the commercial lot.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace the standard parallel lines with high-visibility continental or ladder markings to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of commercial driveways to slow turning vehicles and improve pedestrian safety by shortening the conflict zone.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and RRFBs to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or buffer zone with trees to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the walking environment.
